about: One entry per surface id: a recipe that makes a material. Every number is {value, unit, kind, source}; check-presets fails an entry without kind and source. height_recipe names a function in place_kit/surfaces/heights.py (soft large shapes, nothing under about 5 mm). tile_metres is the real size of one picture repeat. uv_method: box (one box mapping in metres), planar (from above), plank (u along the length, v across, random offset per plank). normal_strength is the Normal Map node strength (multiplied by 0.6 where displacement is on). displacement_depth_metres is used only for roles with displace true. Most values are first tries marked judged (from the garden and mine work) or invented; judge by looking.
